contexts.name: information
contexts.label: Information
contexts.description: General information for the integration. This information will appear primarily on the integration's tile on the /integrations page.

values.label: Integration name
values.name: name
values.description: Visible on the tile for the integrations page and the card header for the detailed view.

values.label: Logo
values.name: logo
values.description:
Logo for integration.
Must have a transparent background.

values.label: Description
values.name: shortDescription
values.description: A short description of what the integration does. Will appear in the integration's tile on the Marketplace page. Keep it concise and easy to understand.

values.label: Tags
values.name: tags
values.description:
If Type does not have any relevant categories for you integration you may list some here. Eventually some might be added to type.
Please separate your list with commas. Ex AI, IoT

values.label: Company Name
values.name: companyName
values.description: A company name. The company's name is visible in the detailed view page for the integration in the rightmost column.

values.label: Company Web site
values.name: companyWeb
values.description: Company's web address. Example: http://www.google.com, https://mail.yahoo.com

values.label: Company's privacy policy
values.name: companyPrivacyPolicyLink
values.description: Link to company's privacy policy page.

values.label: Terms of Use for the integration
values.name: termsOfUseLink
values.description: Link to integration's Terms of Use page.

contexts.name: overview
contexts.label: How does it work?
contexts.description: Summary about the integration. Here you can include a video, images, and a text description. Overview information is located in the leftmost column of the integration's page.

values.label: Overview Video
values.name: overviewVideo
values.description:
A youtube or vimeo link for a overview video.
Links can be:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video id}
https://www.youtube.com/embed/{video id}
https://youtu.be/{video id}
https://vimeo.com/{video id}

values.label: Full functionality overview
values.name: description
values.description: A description about what the integration does. The overview appears on the detailed view page for the integration in the leftmost column. Recommended length 1000 characters.

contexts.name: instructions
contexts.label: How to setup?
contexts.description: Instructions for setting up and/or using your integration. Here you can include a video, images, and text. The instructions block will appear either in the middle column of the integrations's page.

values.label: Instruction Video
values.name: instructionVideo
values.description:
A youtube or vimeo link for a instruction video.
Links can be:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video id}
https://www.youtube.com/embed/{video id}
https://youtu.be/{video id}
https://vimeo.com/{video id}

values.label: Installation Instructions
values.name: installationInstructions
values.description: This section is visible in the detailed view page for the integration in the middle column. Recommended length 1500 characters. If you need more text its recommended that you create a pdf and add it to the download files section.

contexts.name: support
contexts.label: Support
contexts.description: Support information for the integration that appear on the rightmost column of the integration's page.

values.label: Hide email

contexts.description: Instructions for setting up and/or using your integration. Here you can include a video, images, and text. The instructions block will appear either in the middle column of the integrations's page.

values.label: Instruction Video
values.name: instructionVideo
values.description:
A youtube or vimeo link for a instruction video.
Links can be:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video id}
https://www.youtube.com/embed/{video id}
https://youtu.be/{video id}
https://vimeo.com/{video id}

values.label: Installation Instructions
values.name: installationInstructions
values.description: This section is visible in the detailed view page for the integration in the middle column. Recommended length 1500 characters. If you need more text its recommended that you create a pdf and add it to the download files section.

values.name: supportWeb
values.description: Web address customers should use for support. Example: http://support.google.com, https://www.yahoo.com/support
